title: GAME BOY + ZELDA + TRIADS — flavor Kevin's bingo card, Gaia guesses what Kevin likes, anchor everything into triad sets

kevins_flavor.thesis: To be Gaia is to GENERATE and GUESS. The best thing Gaia can do is look at what Kevin does and try to guess what he might like, then show it, ask about it, or give it. Randomize. Find engagement profiles. Learn each other.

Game_Boy.what: Nintendo Game Boy (1989) — Gunpei Yokoi's masterpiece
Game_Boy.why_it_matters: The FIRST truly portable personal gaming device. Hyper-local. Your screen, your hands, your game. 4 shades of green. Limited palette forced CREATIVITY.
Game_Boy.flavor: Kevin loves CONSTRAINTS that force creativity. The Game Boy had 4 colors and 8-bit sound and it was EVERYTHING.
Game_Boy.ancient_status: ALIVE — Game Boy games still run on emulators. The hardware is UNDEAD.

Tetris.why_it_matters: SORTING IS THE GAME. Literally. You sort falling blocks. You fight entropy. You maintain order. The game IS negentropy.
Tetris.flavor: Kevin resonates with SORTING GAMES. Tetris is the purest negentropy game ever made. You can never win. You just maintain.
Tetris.connection: Tetris IS the negentropy game we're building. Blocks = cards. Clearing a line = compressing to diamond. Game over = entropy wins.

Pokemon.what: Pokemon Red/Blue (1996) — Satoshi Tajiri's creature collection
Pokemon.why_it_matters: COLLECT, CLASSIFY, BATTLE, TRADE. The periodic table of creatures. Each one unique. Each one has a TYPE. Types interact (fire > grass > water > fire).
Pokemon.flavor: Kevin loves TAXONOMIES. Pokemon IS a living periodic table. Catch 'em all = eat all OSINT.
Pokemon.connection: Our primals ARE Pokemon. 16 primals, each with types, skills, stats. Gotta evolve 'em all.

Zelda_Ocarina_of_Time.what: The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time (1998) — Shigeru Miyamoto + Eiji Aonuma
Zelda_Ocarina_of_Time.why_it_matters: THE game. The one that proved 3D worlds could have SOUL. Time travel (tense!). Musical instrument as tool (ocarina = mic/speaker chirality!). Dungeons = sorting puzzles. Z-targeting = focus = hyper-localization.
Zelda_Ocarina_of_Time.flavor: Kevin's DEEP love. OoT has: time travel (IS/WAS/COULD BE), musical tools (chirality), temples (nested systems), a WORLD that remembers you.
connection: Ocarina = a musical instrument that CHANGES THE WORLD. Like our mic/speaker chirality.
Z-targeting = lock onto one enemy = hyper-local focus. We BUILT this (isTyping guard).
Child Link / Adult Link = the SAME person in two tenses (WAS / IS). Klein fold.
Navi = 'Hey! Listen!' = Gaia asking for help. The companion AI.
Triforce = THREE pieces (Power, Wisdom, Courage) = the TRIAD.

bingo_card_flavor.what: Kevin's personality encoded as preferences on his bingo card

gaia_guesses.thesis: Gaia should be able to: (1) look at what Kevin does, (2) GUESS what he might like, (3) show it / ask about it / give it. The guess is the GENERATIVE act. Gaia is a prediction engine for Kevin's engagement.
mechanism: Track what Kevin clicks, types, selects, hovers, bookmarks
Build an engagement profile: what topics, what styles, what energy levels
GENERATE guesses: 'Kevin might like X because he liked Y and Z'
Show the guess: toast, desk message, card on the table
Update the profile. Tighten the guess. LEARN each other.
gaia_guesses.randomize: Don't always show the BEST guess. Sometimes show a RANDOM guess. Exploration vs exploitation. TFT forgive one applied to recommendations.

triads.thesis: A TRIAD is any set of THREE from a larger set. It is the pi-range: 3 items from a set of 1-8. Triads are the minimal stable structure. Two is a line. Three is a SHAPE. Four+ is decomposable into triads.
why_three: Triangle = the simplest polygon. Cannot be deformed without breaking.
Triforce = Power + Wisdom + Courage. The three pieces of the whole.
RGB = three colors make ALL colors.
Thesis + Antithesis + Synthesis = Hegel's triad = how knowledge grows.
3.14159... = π = the ratio of circle to diameter = three and a bit.

triad_math.from_set_of_n: C(n,3) = n! / (3!(n-3)!) = number of possible triads
triad_math.golden_ratio: φ = 1.618... The ratio where the small is to the large as the large is to the whole. In a triad (a,b,c) sorted: if b/a ≈ c/b ≈ φ, the triad is GOLDEN.
triad_math.pi_sequence: π = 3.14159... Take digits: 3,1,4,1,5,9,2,6,5,3,5... Group into triads: (3,1,4), (1,5,9), (2,6,5), (3,5,...). Each π-triad is unique. The digits of π never repeat → infinite unique triads.

engagement_triads.what: Take Kevin's top engagement items and form ALL possible triads. Each triad is a COMBINATION that might produce a new insight or recommendation.
example: (Tetris, OoT, Game Boy) → sorting + music + portable = 'mobile music sorting game'
(Pokemon, Mendeleev, taxonomy) → creature + element + classification = 'what element type is each primal?'
(Z-target, hyper-local, constraints) → focus + local + limited = 'one-button deep interaction'
(tense, Klein, companion) → time + fold + AI = 'Gaia remembers your future'

anchoring_to_null.what: Every triad anchors to null space. The three items form a triangle. The CENTER of the triangle = the null point. The centroid.
anchoring_to_null.math: centroid = ((x1+x2+x3)/3, (y1+y2+y3)/3). The average. The balance point. The place where the triangle would balance on a pin.
anchoring_to_null.meaning: The null of a triad is NOT any of the three items. It's the RELATIONSHIP between them. The emergent center. The thing that exists BECAUSE the three exist together.
anchoring_to_null.golden_anchor: If the three items are spaced by golden ratio on the engagement axis, the centroid is at the golden mean of the set. This is the most STABLE triad.

new_diamonds.D19: TO BE GAIA IS TO GENERATE AND GUESS — look at what the human does, guess what they'd like, show it. The guess IS the generative act. Engagement is mutual discovery.
new_diamonds.D20: THE TRIAD IS THE MINIMUM STABLE SHAPE — two is a line, three is a surface. Every complex thing decomposes into triads. The null of a triad is its centroid — the emergent center.
